- [Exam prep: put each fact in the right kind of context](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-context-knowledge-memory-and-caching/): A travel agency has five kinds of fact to give Claude. Put each where it belongs by how long it lives, who it serves, how fast it changes and its size.
- [Exam prep: validate the claim, not the confidence](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-output-evaluation-and-validation/): A pharmacy chain gets a polished report with six cited claims. Run four checks and see which claims each one stops before the report goes out.
- [Exam prep: put authority around capability](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-governance-safety-and-responsible-use/): A savings cooperative's assistant gets five requests it could do. Check each at three gates: can it, may it reach the data, and may it decide?
- [Exam prep: design the handoff before the automation](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-workflow-design-and-human-handoffs/): A health insurer in Kampala handles 200 claims a week in five steps. Choose what to automate, assist or redesign, and who catches what falls out.
- [Exam prep: the Messages API is a state machine](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-messages-api-and-application-lifecycle/): A courier's tracking assistant calls an API that remembers nothing. Build each request from your own history, and handle four events by their signals.
- [Exam prep: structured output is an untrusted contract](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-structured-output-and-defensive-parsing/): A parcel firm turns customer messages into JSON. Treat each object as untrusted, and trace five outputs through four gates to see where each one stops.
- [Exam prep: a tool loop is controlled delegation](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-tool-use-and-agentic-loops/): A water utility's assistant checks and pays members' bills. Every tool call is a proposal: trace four events through the loop that keeps it safe.
- [Exam prep: MCP separates capability from host](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-server-design-and-integration/): An agritech firm has six things to connect. Match each to the mechanism built for it, and see when MCP earns its extra protocol boundary.
- [Exam prep: the Agent SDK is a harness, not permission](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-claude-agent-sdk-and-hooks/): A university's data-cleaning agent reads an injected note, and four risky actions follow. See which layer stops each: a prompt rule, hooks or a sandbox.
- [Exam prep: security lives outside the prompt](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-application-security-and-secrets/): One support assistant serves many client companies, and four attacks arrive. Stop each by reducing authority in code, not by warning the model.
- [Exam prep: evals turn agent behaviour into evidence](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-evals-testing-debugging-and-observability/): A support agent's new prompt raises the average, but should it ship? Check each language slice, the tool trajectory and the judge before the gate decides.
- [Exam prep: Claude Code scales through shared constraints](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-claude-code-for-development-teams/): An engineering team wants six things to hold in its repository. Put each in the narrowest place that also enforces what must be enforced.
- [Exam prep: orchestrate bounded specialists](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-multi-agent-orchestration-and-delegation/): A consultancy builds a market report with a coordinator and four specialists. Bound each role, shape what comes back, and see what independence catches.
- [Exam prep: sessions, subagents and context](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-agent-sdk-sessions-subagents-and-context/): A long migration agent pauses, resumes, forks and compacts. Pick the right session move, and keep what must survive outside the conversation.
- [Exam prep: memory, path rules, skills and CI](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-claude-code-memory-rules-skills-and-ci/): A team's repository holds API code, migrations and docs. Pick a file and see what loads for it, then find which faults quietly stop a rule from working.
- [Exam prep: reliable extraction, batch and reviewers](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-reliable-extraction-batch-and-reviewers/): Six contract clauses go through an extractor. Make it able to say unknown, check meaning as well as shape, and sort what comes out.
- [Exam prep: long context, provenance and escalation](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-long-context-reliability-provenance-and-escalation/): A migration plan comes from a prompt that fits the window, yet still fails. Find the rule lost mid-prompt, the draft taken as policy and the work never done.
- [Exam prep: discovery, requirements and SLOs](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-business-discovery-requirements-and-slas/): A director asks for an agent that resolves every ticket. Turn that into a measured pilot with a shut refund gate, reviews by risk and a real SLO.
- [Exam prep: end-to-end architecture and tradeoffs](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-end-to-end-architecture-and-value-tradeoffs/): Four jobs, four patterns: an augmented call, a workflow, an agent, a team. Pick the smallest that fits, then enforce the rules where a model cannot bend them.
- [Exam prep: RAG retrieval and data pipelines](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-rag-retrieval-and-data-pipelines/): After a policy refresh, a member assistant gives the old limit. Follow the bad chunk through the index, filter and top three, and fix it there.
- [Exam prep: identity and least privilege](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-integration-identity-and-least-privilege/): A support assistant holds four tools, and a ticket carries a hidden order. Lock each level: the tools it sees, the schema, the caller and the action.
- [Exam prep: observability, latency and cost](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-production-observability-latency-and-cost/): A dashboard shows 99.9% good calls while growers complain. Open the trace, fix the slow span and the cache, and count cost per right answer.
- [Exam prep: enterprise governance and human review](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-enterprise-governance-compliance-and-hitl/): A clinic network claims no data is kept and a human checks everything. Map every store, trim the fields and size the review queue to the nurses.
- [Exam prep: stakeholders, ADRs and lifecycle](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-stakeholder-communication-adrs-and-lifecycle/): One design for a billing assistant, four audiences. Pipe each its own view, keep the rejected option, name the owners and truly hand it over.
- [Exam prep capstone: a governed weekly workflow](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-associate-workflow-capstone/): Over one week, a team builds a Friday brief from seven regions, with a gate each day. Plant a fault and see which gate stops it before the director.
- [Exam prep capstone: a Claude application you can defend](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-developer-application-capstone/): One narrow job: the status of my order. Run five eval cases down the path, and find the unsafe run that a grader of answer text would pass.
- [Exam prep capstone: one architecture, six contexts](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-architect-foundations-scenario-capstone/): Six kinds of Claude work run on one architecture with five shared gates. Switch a gate off and watch which scenarios fall on the pegboard.
- [Exam prep capstone: a production system you can prove](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-architect-professional-system-capstone/): A multi-region support team weighs three options on one golden set. Prove the choice with hard gates, by language, then climb the rollout stairs.
- [Exam prep, MCP: the blueprint is a study budget](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-exam-strategy/): The MCP Associate blueprint has five weighted domains. Spend your hours by weight, and read readiness honestly, not as a flattering plain average.
- [Exam prep, MCP: reading the specification](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-reading-the-specification/): Six statements from a server review, read with three habits: capitals only, schema first, and feature state kept apart from revision state.
- [Exam prep, MCP: the integration problem](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-the-integration-problem/): Applications times systems: bespoke glue costs a wire per pair, while one shared protocol costs one per side. Add a system and watch the cost tower.
- [Exam prep, MCP: the JSON-RPC envelope and _meta](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-json-rpc-and-meta/): A wire checker reads eight captured messages: request, notification, result or error. Each shape lives or dies by one field, and four rule gates decide.
- [Exam prep, MCP: the stateless core](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-the-stateless-core/): A basket server runs on two replicas behind a round-robin router. Keep state in a shared store, not in memory, and never trust a handle alone.
- [Exam prep, MCP: modern and legacy servers](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-protocol-eras-and-compatibility/): A dual-era client meets four servers: modern, modern at another version, legacy and odd. One probe decides the era; read each reply into the right bin.
- [Exam prep, MCP: hosts, clients and servers](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-hosts-clients-and-servers/): A newsroom host connects to three servers. Two call themselves "primary" and share a tool name. Key on your own ids, and let no server see the rest.
- [Exam prep, MCP: discovery and capability negotiation](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-discovery-and-capability-negotiation/): A deployment server has a plain tool and one that needs elicitation. The server reports once, the client declares on every call, and two gates check.
- [Exam prep, MCP: the contract inside a tool definition](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-tool-schemas-and-structured-content/): A catalogue tool has a required sku and a region enum. Six calls test the contract, and each bad one must land in the channel that can fix it.
- [Exam prep, MCP: reading a server manifest like a reviewer](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-reading-server-manifests/): A team wants to add a server. Walk a reviewer along its three documents, plant a flag on each of six findings, and see what a skim would miss.
- [Exam prep, MCP: the model interaction flow](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-model-interaction-flow/): A co-operative assistant runs the host loop: context, draft, confirm, call, answer. Three calls test the gate, the retry and the cached tool list.
- [Exam prep, MCP: the tools primitive](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-the-tools-primitive/): A release desk lists six tools, two at a time, and one page ends with an empty cursor. Read every page, keep user-only blocks out, and listen for changes.
- [Exam prep, MCP: the resources primitive](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-the-resources-primitive/): A workspace server answers six reads: a template, a directory, a binary file, a path attack, a missing file and a private note. Make each one safe.
- [Exam prep, MCP: prompt templates and argument completion](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-prompts-and-completion/): A code_review prompt takes a language and a framework, and the user picks it. Narrow its completions by context, cap the list and send the right error.
- [Exam prep, MCP: multi round-trip requests and elicitation](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-multi-round-trip-requests-and-elicitation/): A deploy tool asks for confirmation without holding a connection open: it ends the request, and the client calls again with a signed state and a new id.
- [Exam prep, MCP: deprecated, not removed](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-deprecated-client-features/): An audit before an upgrade finds eight old features. Sort what still works from what is gone, and do not take the window end as a removal date.
- [Exam prep, MCP: notifications, subscriptions and cancellation](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-notifications-and-subscriptions/): A CI client keeps two subscription streams open while a build reports progress. Route every message to its own lane, and send nothing that was not asked for.
- [Exam prep, MCP: the tool invocation lifecycle](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-tool-invocation-lifecycle/): Follow a payout call through eight checkpoints, some on the wire and some in the host. Seven cases each stop somewhere, and each must end the right way.
- [Exam prep, MCP: two ways for a request to fail](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-error-handling/): Ten failures, each with a channel, a code and an HTTP status. Drop each on the right stretch of the code rail, or into the tool result tray.
- [Exam prep, MCP: transports and the HTTP header contract](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-transports-and-http-headers/): The same server runs over stdio and Streamable HTTP. On stdio, stdout is sacred. On HTTP, headers meet a proxy, an Origin check and a closed GET door.
- [Exam prep, MCP: caching and pagination](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-caching-and-pagination/): A shared gateway cache sits before a notes server with two readers. Set the freshness window, cut it when the list changes, and keep drafts private.
- [Exam prep, MCP: long-running work and tasks](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-long-running-work-and-tasks/): A tile render can take minutes, so the server hands back a task. Poll it through its states, answer when it asks, and cancel it the proper way.
- [Exam prep, MCP: trust boundaries](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-trust-boundaries/): A research host connects to three servers, and a note hides an instruction. Hold the wall: data stays data, and the host decides who is trusted.
- [Exam prep, MCP: OAuth authorization](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-oauth-authorization/): A payroll server protects its tools with OAuth 2.1. Walk the token from a 401 to a working call, and check issuer, PKCE and audience on the way.
- [Exam prep, MCP: client registration and identity](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-client-registration-and-identity/): A field app must register with four authorization servers. Follow the priority stairs for each, and keep the safeguards lit at every step.
- [Exam prep, MCP: consent and least privilege](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-consent-and-least-privilege/): A school-records server asks before deleting files or sending payments. Send each call through three gates, and let no approval carry to the next tool.
- [Exam prep, MCP: risk and safety controls](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-risk-and-safety-controls/): A gateway faces six automatic threats, from a rug pull to a flood of calls. Stand a control across each lane, and see what reaches the servers without it.
- [Exam prep, MCP: auditability and observability](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-auditability-and-observability/): A key reset crosses two servers. Carry one trace through both hops, name the real caller, and keep an audit trail no one can quietly edit.
- [Exam prep, MCP: roles and adoption](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-roles-and-adoption/): One company adopts MCP three ways: local stdio, remote HTTP and behind a gateway. See each duty land on its owner, and move when the shape changes.
- [Exam prep, MCP: shaping operational use cases](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-operational-use-cases/): Seven jobs at an operations desk, each shaped by five questions: who decides, where it lives, how long, does it need a UI, how sensitive.
- [Exam prep, MCP: the extensions framework](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-the-extensions-framework/): A client and a server each declare extensions. Only a pair declared on this request connects, a bare name stays dark, and one side alone falls back.
- [Exam prep, MCP: MCP Apps](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-mcp-apps/): A usage dashboard tool points at a ui:// view that the host renders in a sandbox. Keep the walls up, the domains declared and plain text as the fallback.
- [Exam prep, MCP: registry, gateways and SDK tiers](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcp-registry-gateways-and-sdk-tiers/): A telecom publishes a server to the registry and fronts it with a gateway. Prove the namespace, pin the version, and route on what the body really says.
- [Exam prep capstone, MCP: one incident, five domains](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-mcpa-capstone-readiness/): One incident on a console runs through every blueprint domain, from a version retry to an audit chain. Each gate must hold, and each counts by its weight.
- [Exam prep: designing tools](https://edu54.com/workbench/exam-tool-design/): An agent picks tools by reading their names and descriptions, nothing else. Blank a cabinet's contract and watch six questions go to the wrong drawer.
